jobId.description: Becomes a directory name under `project-data/jobs/`. The pattern is defence in depth — `jobDir()` in @cutdown/skill-runtime guards and containment-checks it regardless of caller, because a skill's `entrypoint` is a documented direct invocation.

edlId.description: The PlatformEDL to render. Must be a ULID: it becomes a FILENAME under the job (and, for outputs, a directory that is created on the way), so a traversing value would read or write inside another job. The skill asserts it again before joining, because a skill's `entrypoint` is a documented direct invocation and a schema-only guard has the same bypass shape the Phase 2 HIGH had.

tier.description: D-34. `final` requires an approved draft; there is no flag that waives that.

approvedDraftManifestId.description: Required for `final`: the draft manifest whose approval authorises this render. The skill verifies the approval record exists and names this manifest. It must be a ULID: the value becomes a directory name (`renders/draft/<id>/manifest.json`), so a traversing value would read a manifest outside the job. The skill asserts it again before joining, because a skill's `entrypoint` is a documented direct invocation.

styleProfilePath.description: Optional StyleProfile supplying caption colours and the brand background.

waiverPaths.description: QaWaiver records to apply to this render's warnings (D-35). A waiver naming a blocker is rejected, not ignored.

audioEventsPath.description: Optional indexed audio events, so meaningful non-speech moments can be surfaced for caption review (REQ-104). Absent means that check records `skipped` with a reason rather than reporting clean.
